name: General Test Report Pack
purpose: Generate a structured, cross-project test report summarizing execution results, defects, coverage, risks, and release recommendations.
when_to_use: summarizing test execution results after a test cycle
reporting feature, regression, integration, or UAT test outcomes
providing release readiness assessment with defect and risk summary
documenting test conclusions for stakeholder sign-off
notes: Use the general-test/report/test-report.md template for the output structure.
Apply general-test/report/test-report-checklist.md as a dedicated quality gate.
Escalate to workflow.full_default if the report requires deeper investigation or remediation planning.
